name: tree_own_screen_v1
campaign: final-week campaign (6 October 2026), lever 3 (fork C): the 15 own-aircraft turnaround columns as inputs to the tree members of the stack
status: screen: 2025 development months only; no official score, no leaderboard, no submission file, nothing uploaded
question: The guarded stacker v3 and the v65 network member carry the own-aircraft turnaround points (tunnel 18 / tunnel 21); the tree members never saw them. Does a tree member refitted with them improve v65's development chain once stack_resid_v3 is refitted on the rebuilt components?

lirf_table.table: ens_v22_lirf_q (runs/adsb_v22/ens_v22_lirf_q; 48 members: 3 LightGBM x4, 4 CatBoost x9)
lirf_table.why: LIRF non-population rows are the largest remaining cells of the v61 census (LIRF dark 21.2% + LIRF unmatched 10.7% of ordinary squared error); the LIRF tree has weight 0.45 on lirf_nonpop_matched and 0.25/0.60 on lirf_nonpop_unmatched rows; no shipped LIRF component sees the own points (LIRF keeps stack_resid_v2; the v65 member skips LIRF)

committee.table: ens_v20_bag_q_all (runs/adsb_v20/ens_v20_bag_q_all; 468 members: 9 LightGBM x13, 13 CatBoost x27)
committee.why: the committee enters the non-LIRF mix at share 0.15 (0.5 where it sits more than 1,200 s above the networks) and the stacker reads its disagreement with the networks; the x19 LightGBM family already takes the v19 extras, so own points are a column extension

insertion_points.not_screened: CatBoost leaves (1.7-3 h per fit; a development round may refit the four LIRF CatBoost leaves if the LightGBM screen is GO), the residual stage (adj2 / cat carry 0.05 each of matched non-LIRF rows: too little leverage)

own_columns.source: data/external/adsblol/features_v19own/features_v19_<month>.parquet (tools/build_ownpoints_features.py; tunnel 18's 14 raw columns + p_has_inb; label-free, departure BLOCK_TIME blanked on load)

fits.tool: tools/run_tree_own.py (LightGBM only, 16 threads, one fit at a time per worker)

variants.ctl: the leaf's own recipe and inputs (its features_v19 extras, if any)
variants.own: the same recipe + the 15 own columns appended after the leaf's extras

folds.lomo_2025-01: twelve-month refit population minus January 2025 (tools/run_adsb_learner_lomo.py's construction), fixed rounds; the January 2025 development table
folds.forward: tools/run_adsb_learner.py's forward fold (fit January-September, early stopping October with the leaf's cap and patience, score November); the November development table
folds.jan_nov: the January-November refit population (hold-out 2025-12 of the same construction), fixed rounds; the December development table

fits.rounds: fixed folds: the leaf's twelve-month rule (median of its recorded seasonal and forward best iterations) for both variants; forward: early stopping for both variants
fits.count: 6 leaves x 2 variants x 4 folds = 48 LightGBM fits
fits.workers: arcw4-arcw7 (fork C's lane), deallocated right after their SHA-256-checked mirror

control_reproduction.requirement: before any candidate is read: every ctl fit equals the saved leaf it re-fits -- lomo months against runs/lomo_dev/learners/<leaf>/lomo_<month>/predictions.parquet and forward against <leaf>/forward/predictions.parquet with maximum absolute difference 0.0; jan_nov's model byte-identical to <leaf>/refit/model.txt (the leaf's January-November refit) and its December predictions against runs/december/learners (the documented ADS-B neighbour tie-order rows of docs/lomo_dev/README.md are reported, not a failure). A failure stops the screen and is reported.
control_reproduction.deltas: candidate deltas are own minus ctl from the same fit path, so refit noise and the December tie-order rows cancel

tables.rebuild: each development month's table is rebuilt from its saved leaves with the frozen member rule (prc2026_december.scoring.leaf_members + ensemble_prediction, nanmean with multiplicities) and must equal runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet's committee / lirf_tree within 1e-9 s before any candidate

candidates.lirf_exact: ens_v22_lirf_q with each of the three LIRF LightGBM leaves replaced by saved + (own - ctl) inside the frozen member list (group share 12/48)
candidates.lirf_fam100: ens_v22_lirf_q + 1.0 x D_lirf; D_lirf = per-row mean over the three LIRF LightGBM leaves with a finite (own - ctl) of that difference, 0 where none is finite (the LightGBM family's change applied as if the whole table moved with it)
candidates.com_exact: ens_v20_bag_q_all with each of the three x19 LightGBM leaves replaced by saved + (own - ctl) inside the frozen member list (group share 39/468)
candidates.com_fam100: ens_v20_bag_q_all + 1.0 x D_com, D_com defined as D_lirf over the three x19 LightGBM leaves

reading.chain: v65's development chain with the candidate tables in runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet: v46 (recomputed with the candidate committee) -> v51m' = the own-points member own_all at 0.40 in place of the combination (configs/ctx_ownpoints_dev_v1.json, v65's member) -> v52m (masked member 0.40) -> LIRF layers v45 gate, v53m, v54m, v55m recomputed on the candidate LIRF tree (tools/build_dev_model_part.py's arithmetic) -> no-NM rematch -> v48 reconciliation -> extreme-day -> variance re-allocation (shipped parameters) -> stack_resid_v3 refitted on the rebuilt components, LIRF taking v2 refitted (as docs/ctx_ownpoints_dev stage 2) -> intruder bound -> identity extension -> own-motion v1 -> own_motion_v2
reading.control: the v65 development proxy runs/ctx_ownpoints_dev/chain/own_all_w40/dev_v65_proxy.parquet column v65 (SHA-256 32c9458d3a52677484da9a51366baa65024dd6a279d02e5fecae89300b09bc94)
reading.identity: with zero deltas the tool reproduces the v65 model part (runs/ctx_ownpoints_dev/chain/own_all_w40/dmp.parquet) within 1e-9 s and the v65 proxy within 1e-6 s before any candidate is scored
reading.intervals: paired take-off-day bootstrap 95% interval of the month's RMSE change (tools/run_intruder_bound.interval, seed 20261006)
reading.guard: LIRF fill-population rows never change in any candidate (asserted per month); every label, extreme ones included, stays in every RMSE

go_bar: a candidate is GO if its equal-footing mean RMSE change is <= -0.05%, no month (four) is worse than +0.01%, and at least two of the three equal-footing intervals lie below zero
after_go: a declared development round configs/tree_own_dev_v1.json (committed before any further fit) adds the ranking refits (refit12) and, if time allows, the four LIRF CatBoost leaves; acceptance by v57's clauses in-chain against the v65 proxy; a ranking dry run only under runs/tree_own/rank/ (the coordinator assigns any version)
deadline: a candidate must be ready by 9 October 2026 evening UTC; NO GO ends the lever
